name: KOSE Holdings Corporation
summary: KOSE Corporation, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, and formed in 1946, manufactures, markets and sells cosmetic products in Asia, the United States and other markets. Its range includes skincare such as cleansers, toners, moisturizers and masks, as well as makeup, fragrances, hair care, lip care, sun protection and supplements for beauty. Products are sold through specialty cosmetic stores, department stores, drugstores and e-commerce.
